objective: Reproduce the SGC test accuracy on Cora, Citeseer and Pubmed reported in Table 2 of the paper, using this repository's tuned-hyperparameter commands for the citation networks.

expected.why: Runs as documented (`citation.py --dataset cora --tuned`) once scikit-learn is installed; the repo's requirements file cannot be installed as written. Accuracy is essentially seed independent.
README command uses `--epochs 150` for Citeseer; with it the number matches.

notes: Table 2 of arXiv 1902.07153 (pdftotext line): 'SGC        81.0 ± 0.0      71.9 ± 0.1      78.9 ± 0.0' (columns Cora, Citeseer, Pubmed; caption: Test accuracy (%) averaged over 10 runs on citation networks). README: `pip install -r requirement.txt` (the file is named requirements.txt) which pins networkx==1.11 and hyperopt==0.1.1 (not installable on python 3.13); scikit-learn is imported by metrics.py. Fix = install scikit-learn; no source patch needed (networkx 3.x and torch 2.x work as is, with deprecation warnings). Seeds are passed with `--seed`.
